pages.text: Alloyed adds two alloys and the forge that makes them. Steel and bronze become tools, armor and building blocks, and both share tags with other mods' versions (see $(l:materials/shared_metals)Shared Metals$(/l)).

pages.title: Alloy Forge
pages.text: Combines several ingredients into an alloy. Steel: three iron ingots, a coal and a fire charge give three steel. Bronze: copper, zinc nuggets and cinder flour.

pages.title: Steel
pages.text: Shaped like iron but tougher. Forge it into pickaxes, swords, armor, horse armor, shears and fishing rods. Farmer's Delight gets a steel knife.

pages.title: Bronze
pages.text: Used for bronze casing, sheet and blocks. Bronze blocks oxidize like copper (exposed, weathered, oxidized) and can be waxed.

pages.title: Bronze Bell
pages.text: A playable block. It rings when hit or powered by redstone, a Wrench tunes it, and a Deployer can ring it.

Casings: Steel Casing and Bronze Casing, with encased shafts and cogwheels, add more tiers to your builds. Also steel catwalks, mesh fences and doors. Other steel routes: $(l:industry/tfmg_steel)TFMG Steel$(/l).
